_comment: Table Health Advisor settings. orphan_min_age_minutes is test scale (3, the hot window); production should be days (Iceberg's remove_orphan_files default is 3 days = 4320) so in-flight writes are never counted. orphan_scan_every_hours / retained_bytes_every_hours: 0 = whenever the table changed (test); production ~24. advisor_mode: auto | approve-only | off, the default; a table's own advisor.mode property wins. 'defaults' apply to every table; 'tables' overrides per table ('thresholds' merges key by key). Test scale: target file size is 8 MB (64x below Iceberg's 512 MB default) so small test tables show real symptoms. Thresholds were calibrated on the first gl-metrics run of S0-S6 (2026-10-02); production values are noted in the README.

expiry._comment: GL2.6e expiry by policy (expiry.py). Category: streaming when the table had >= streaming_min_commits_24h writer commits in the last 24 h. The table's history.expire.* properties win, then advisor.expire.max-age-hours / advisor.expire.min-snapshots, then these. inflight_floor_hours: the age is never below it; TEST SCALE 0.05 h (3 min, like the hot window), production 24. stale_ref_hours: a tag or branch other than main older than this with no retention of its own is STALE_REF; TEST SCALE 1 h, production ~720 (30 days). retained_bytes (sibling key): full = today's all_files query (rationed by retained_bytes_every_hours) with the summary formula computed and compared; ledger (on since GL2.6f, after 27/27 tables agreed on the cluster) = the summary formula for data bytes, the old-manifest query on retained_bytes_every_hours, and the full all_files query only as the rationed fallback for a table whose formula is unknown (refs other than main, branched history, no size summaries) or not yet computed; off = not measured.

rewrite._comment: Options plan.py puts on the CALLs. min_input_files null = min_excess_files + 1, so every flagged partition is one the rewrite will change.

incremental._comment: GL2.5m incremental scan. Per family: off | shadow (full path decides, both compared in glue.ops.incremental_check) | on (ledger decides; spot_check_share of tables and any table not compared for reconcile_every_days are still compared). Family 1 (snapshot_ledger) passed shadow 2026-10-03 and is on; family 2 (partition_activity) reports and compares only (shadow); family 3 (learned_windows: hot window = 2 x p95 commit gap between hot_partition_minutes and hot_cap_minutes, settle window = p99 lateness up to settle_cap_hours, the hot window needs min_gaps commit gaps after leaving out idle gaps longer than idle_gap_factor x the median gap, the settle window and LATE_ARRIVALS' lateness trigger need min_batches batches) shows what would change (shadow) or decides (on). Family partition_holds (GL2.6b, holds.py; on since 2026-10-04 after s19, s3 and append-live in shadow): the hot hold applies only to commits that removed or rewrote files in the partition, or to a time partition still filling; SMALL_FILES is held per partition while writers rewrote at least thresholds.churn_partition_rate x its bytes in the last churn_window_h (instead of table-wide under REWRITE_CHURN); shadow reports what would change, on decides. A table's optional time_column lets the plan compact an appended-to unpartitioned table's older rows only. Family new_findings (GL2.6c; on since 2026-10-04 after s20 and s12 in shadow): DELETE_FILE_SPRAWL (>= thresholds.delete_sprawl_min_files position delete files in a partition whose delete ratio is under DELETE_BUILDUP's: merge them, auto), RETAINED_STORAGE (bytes only old snapshots reference at least retained_storage_min_bytes and MORE than retained_storage_min_share of the live bytes; 1.0 = more than one extra copy, since one compaction always leaves one copy for the retention window: approval) and METADATA_BLOAT (metadata.json over metadata_max_json_bytes or manifests only old snapshots reference over metadata_max_retained_bytes: approval); the byte limits are test scale, 1/64 of the production placeholders (1 GiB, 8 MiB, 1 GiB). shadow reports what would be added, on adds them. Family expiry_policy (GL2.6e, expiry.py): SNAPSHOT_BUILDUP when the retention policy (defaults.expiry, or the table's history.expire.* properties) would expire at least thresholds.expire_min_snapshots snapshots, instead of the snapshot count / age thresholds; STALE_REF for old tags and branches; the plan expires to the policy. shadow reports what would change; on since GL2.6f (2026-10-05) after s21, s3 and s4 in shadow. Family 4 comes later. Lookback: histogram_days, extended whole days at a time (adaptive_lookback) up to lookback_max_days until a table has min_batches / min_gaps samples. Until a table has min_batches batches, a large append later than cold_start_backfill_hours is labelled possible_backfill.
